comment: What civilizations see and remember (GDD 8.2, CORE simplified: oral memory; stage 3g). Every turn each lived-in settlement sees the cells within sightCells (hunters and gatherers roam far in a turn of decades). Scouts are visible units since stage 6 PR 3a (units.json): what they see goes into memory (GDD 8.2). Oral memory: a cell seen once stays known for oralMemoryYears after it was last seen, then it is forgotten unless the tribe comes back (drawn maps from writing come with later eras). Journeys: a camp may set out for a known place up to journeyCells away; since stage 6 PR 3a it walks in ticks over the cheapest known way (units.json journeyTicksPerCell and terrain) over known land, sea ice and land bridges.
